tools.name: list_events
tools.description: The events PlainQuant has history for (Fed decisions, CPI, jobs reports, US elections, quarterly options expiry, market drops), with ids, names in English and Chinese, and aliases.

tools.name: event_study
tools.description: For each past occurrence of the event, the move of the market (market: US = the S&P 500 via SPY, the default for US events; HK = the Hang Seng Index, from its first close after the news; 'measured' in the answer names it) 2 weeks, 4 weeks and 3 months later (fractions: 0.037 = +3.7%), plus median, s

tools.name: index_move_study
tools.description: Like event_study, for a move of an index found in our prices: index SPY (S&P 500), QQQ (Nasdaq-100) or HSI (Hang Seng Index) moving pct percent (signed: -10 = a fall of 10% or more) within days trading days (a fall without days = from its high). Use for 'what happens if the Nasdaq drops 10% in two d

tools.name: check_stocks
tools.description: Trend and business scores (1-100) for up to 20 US or Hong Kong stocks, the industry ranks behind them, whether each is stretched above its average, and whether the scores have predicted later returns. Accepts tickers (NVDA), HK codes (700) or company names, comma-separated.

tools.name: upcoming_events
tools.description: Fed decisions, CPI and jobs reports scheduled in the next days (default 30, at most 180), copied from each official calendar, each with the link to what the market did after past ones. Use for 'what market events are coming this week'.

tools.name: rule_estimates
tools.description: For each of PlainQuant's library stock-picking rules (US and Hong Kong) at default settings: the plain backtest's return a year beside the honest estimate left after costs, delisted stocks and untuned test periods (fractions: 0.05 = 5% a year), the trade count and the test window. Use for 'does mome

tools.name: market_snapshot
tools.description: US and Hong Kong large stocks today: how many have a strong, good, mixed or weak price trend, how many are stretched above their average, and the strongest and weakest groups by median trend. A description of today, not a forecast. Use for 'how broad is the rally' or 'which sectors are strongest'.

tools.name: company_filings
tools.description: A US stock's important SEC filings in the last days (default 30, at most 90): results, 10-Q and 10-K, officer or director changes, major agreements and deals, 5%+ stakes (13D), with links to the filings on SEC EDGAR. Takes a ticker or company name. Hong Kong is not covered.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "event_study" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "For each past occurrence of the event, the move of the equal-weighted US stock market 2 weeks, 4 weeks and 3 months later (fractions: 0.037 = +3.7%), plus median, share up, worst and best beside any window of the same length. With too few occurrences only the list is given. Give symbol (a ticker or " → after: "For each past occurrence of the event, the move of the market (market: US = the S&P 500 via SPY, the default for US events; HK = the Hang Seng Index, from its first close after the news; 'measured' in the answer names it) 2 weeks, 4 weeks and 3 months later (fractions: 0.037 = +3.7%), plus median, s"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
